integrity: The statements depend on explicit square-root and norm-fiber counts, with a reproducible finite verifier; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: For primes congruent to 3 modulo 4 and exponents at least 2 only; unweighted two-point convolution and constant-input fourth moment; not a sharp arbitrary-coefficient Fourier extension theorem. Historical priority might follow from more general local norm-density results. Independent validation not performed.
title: Exact chord multiplicities and fourth Fourier moment of anisotropic circles over prime-power rings
